clips.title: The story
paras: In Ashenvale, Melyria Frostshadow seeks word of the commander who came before her. Velinde Starsong vanished while fighting the corruption spreading from Felwood, and Melyria sends you to Darnassus for answers.

Melyria Frostshadow keeps watch in Ashenvale, following Velinde Starsong, who once held the same post. A priestess, Velinde was charged with containing demonic corruption spreading south from Felwood. Early reports said she had the danger under control, but her campaign faltered over time. Then she vanished without warning or formal relief, leaving the fight unfinished and her fate unknown.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Velinde Starsong was my predecessor here in Ashenvale Forest. At first it seemed she had the situation in Felwood under control, but little by little her efforts faltered. One day, she simply disappeared.

I was sent here to continue her work. I'm afraid I know nothing of the priestess, however. Perhaps Thyn'tel Bladeweaver, one of the commanders of the Sentinels, knows further details of her disappearance that I was not a party to.
Surely she will understand the import of such information.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Velinde Starsong? That the priestess disappeared some time ago is almost certainly common knowledge. As to further details about the events that surrounded her departure... It would take good reason for me to divulge such information.
